prompt:
Request from the mobile team: customers need to be able to cancel their own orders
from the app. Please add `POST /orders/{order_id}/cancel`:

- 200 with the updated order, same JSON shape as `GET /orders/{order_id}`; reserved
  stock goes back to inventory
- 404 if the order doesn't exist or belongs to another customer (admins may cancel any order)
- 409 if the order can no longer be cancelled (e.g. it has shipped)
- 401 without a valid token
